name: Geometry Aware Contrastive Learning (GeoContrast)
definition: A contrastive learning method that enforces multi-view consistency by using geometric constraints to define positive and negative samples, distinguishing surface points from non-surface points.
summary: GeoContrast is a contrastive learning method that enforces multi-view consistency by constructing positive and negative samples based on 3D geometric projections rather than random pixel sampling.
